title: console page route: PageView's Edit-in-studio opens the metadata-admin page while the app bar's pencil, the app switcher's Studio row and (after objectui#12520) the sidebar's Design open Studio's Interfaces surface for the same page
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named producer. It is the third control in objectui#12520's "one designer, one destination" family. objectui#12520's dev surfaced it in `open_questions[0]` (report on objectui#12520, PR #12539). That card's acceptance passes without it, so it is filed here rather than carried there.

finding · reach: on a console `page` route, the page's own Edit-in-studio button. The producer is named: `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` `openInStudio` navigates to `/apps/APP/metadata/page/NAME`, the metadata-admin page. On the same screen, three other controls go elsewhere:
- the app bar's pencil;
- the app switcher's Studio row (both pinned by `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198`);
- the sidebar's Design entry, once PR #12539 lands.

All three open `/studio/PACKAGE/interfaces?surface=page:NAME` through `appStudioRoutePath`. So the one handle labelled "Edit in studio" is the one that does not open Studio. This is a source reading; no browser measurement has been taken yet.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane, one dev round in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`PageView.tsx`, plus its objectui#10899 and objectui#12198 pins), size S, after PR #12539 lands. Triage grades it. ⛔ This is not a claim.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T15:33Z), query "PageView edit in studio button metadata admin page instead of studio interfaces surface pencil destination": 9 results, top 8 read.
- objectui#12520 is this family's sidebar half.
- objectui#12510 is open and concerns accessible names.
- objectui#12303, #11583, #11167, #11189, #7369 and #5476 are closed and unrelated.

None of them is this card.

## The choice the dev's question carries

- **A (the dev's recommendation):** route `openInStudio` through `appStudioRoutePath`, with the same rule objectui#12520 used. When the app has no owning package, the button hides, as the pencil does. ⛔ It never falls back to metadata-admin.
- **B:** leave it as it is, with two destinations on one screen.

**The cost of A to weigh at grading:** today, for a page whose app has no owning package, the button opens the metadata-admin editor, which works there. Under A it hides. objectui#12520 accepted the same trade for the sidebar (the pencil parity rule), so A extends an applied rule rather than starting a new product question. Triage or the maintainer may still regrade.

## Acceptance (under A)

- On a page route, Edit-in-studio's target equals the app bar pencil's target, for the same page.
- With no owning package, it is not drawn.
- The objectui#10899 and objectui#12198 pins are updated deliberately, each naming this card.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root is green on the affected files. The changeset is `patch`.

Blocked-by: #12520

Attribution: written by the `domain:ui` seat 1 in session `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`, from objectui#12520's dev report (`open_questions[0]`).
